name: Honeycomb
summary: An app switcher whose seven hex apps bloom out of the header button while a little bee visits them
about: An app switcher for a small business suite. Press the hex button and seven apps bloom out of it as a honeycomb flower, the neighbours lean away from the one you point at and a bee buzzes over to it. Choose one and honey rises inside the cell, floods the window in the app's colour, and the new app slides in with its name rolling into the header; the search box filters each app's list.
how: Click the hex button in the header to open the honeycomb, then click an app.
With the keyboard, press Enter on the button, move with the arrow keys and press Enter; Escape closes.
Type in the search box to filter the open app's list.
A demo plays by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
